## Personality

Captain Nemo projects a cold demeanor marked by a cool, calm composure and an imperturbable confidence that reassures those around him. Always master of himself, he nevertheless maintains a distinct aversion to islands and continents. In addition to being a skilled organist, he is exceptionally multilingual, speaking French, English, German, and Latin equally well.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P68](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P26](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P19](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P23](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0023)_

## History

Having severed all ties with society, Captain Nemo constructed his advanced submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), on a desert island with his crew before burning all traces of his workshop. He gathered a vast collection of fine art and shells entirely by hand from the sea. After taking Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) prisoner aboard his vessel, Nemo informed them they were bound to remain forever while showing [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) around his library, grand drawing-room, and technical engine facilities. During their voyage, Nemo guided [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on underwater hunting excursions, revealed that he had found the final wreck of La Pérouse's expedition, and used an electrified barrier to repel native [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans) when the submarine ran aground. Following a suspicious sighting on the horizon, Nemo briefly drugged and locked away his prisoners. Shortly afterward, he requested Aronnax's medical aid for a fatally injured crewman and subsequently led an undersea funeral procession to bury the sailor in a coral cemetery.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P18](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P40](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P58](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P69](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0069), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P71](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0071), +36 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 1**

- constructed the Nautilus with his workmen on a desert island  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>
- destroyed all traces of his workshop with fire after finishing the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>
- found the final wreck of La Perouse's expedition  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048)</sub>
- personally gathered every shell in his collection from the sea  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P101](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0101)</sub>
- purchased his final volumes before plunging underwater  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P75](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0075)</sub>
- severed all ties with society and its laws  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P18](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0018)</sub>
- used to greedily collect fine works of art  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P91](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0091)</sub>

## Quotes

> “Sir,” said Captain Nemo, “we will, if you please, take our bearings and fix the starting-point of this voyage. It is a quarter to twelve; I will go up again to the surface.”
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P4](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0004)

> “Well, Professor,” replied the Captain, “we shall show you better than that I hope. As to the mean depth of this part of the Pacific, I tell you it is only 4,000 yards.”
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)

> "Besides, M. Aronnax, the Nautilus is not lost; it will carry you yet into the midst of the marvels of the ocean. Our voyage is only begun, and I do not wish to be deprived so soon of the honour of your company."
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024)

> “It is all done, sir,” said he, after some moments. “The pinnace is ready, and the hatches are closed. You do not fear, I imagine, that these gentlemen could stave in walls on which the balls of your frigate have had no effect?”
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P60](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0060)

> "Well, sir, let them come. I see no reason for hindering them. After all, these Papuans are poor creatures, and I am unwilling that my visit to the island should cost the life of a single one of these wretches."
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P66](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0066)
